main.description: The group's website: static files its host serves as they are at the group's address there, `https://<address>/`, each page sandboxed to an origin of its own. Kept in the group's public repo and written by those whose roles carry group.configure; each publish replaces it, and deleting it takes the site down.

files.description: What the site serves, each at a path of its own.

notFound.description: The path of a file in `files` served, with status 404, for a path no file has.

fallback.description: The path of a file in `files` served, with status 200, for a page no file has, as a single-page app routes in the browser: a request asking for `text/html`, or for a path whose last segment has no extension. Taken before `notFound`; anything else missing gets `notFound`.

createdAt.description: When this version of the site was published.

path.description: Where it is served under the site's root: `/`-separated, with no leading `/`, no empty, `.` or `..` segment. `x/index.html` is served at `x/` too.

contentType.description: The `Content-Type` it is served with, such as `text/html; charset=utf-8`; without it, the type its path's extension names.
